summary.text: LØFLO INSTALLASJON AS is a private limited company registered in Hornindal, founded 2017-09-21. LØFLO INSTALLASJON AS is an electrical installation contractor that provides advice, design, installation and inspection of electrical systems and fire-related equipment, and may take part in companies with similar purposes. It was previously named NYE LØFLO INSTALLASJON AS until 2017-12-27. Its main industry code is 43.210: electrical installation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 13 729 141 NOK and the annual result was 1 485 560 NOK; operating income was up from 12 082 129 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 670 521 NOK in 2024 to 1 485 560 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 6 964 577 NOK in 2024 to 6 380 137 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Stig Olav Lødemel (daglig leder and styrets leder), with 2 other board members. The registered employee count went from 11 on 2025-12-13 to 8 on 2026-08-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
